nodes.name: inventory.php
nodes.summary: Staff/admin inventory management page for the `inventory` table: CSRF-protected add / update_quantity / delete actions (delete is blocked when `booking_inventory` references the item), a red low-stock alert banner computed inline from non-reusable items at or below threshold, and an inline JS edit modal. Not standalone — it opens with requireRole(['admin','staff']) and relies on index.php having already loaded config.php/functions.php and defined $user/$role.
nodes.languageNotes: Laravel-style Blade echo (`<?= ?>`) and inline CSS/JS are embedded directly in the PHP template; every mutating branch calls setFlash() then header('Location: index.php?page=inventory') and exit (POST-redirect-GET).

nodes.name: notifications.php
nodes.summary: Small staff-only notification inbox that lists the last 50 `notifications` rows for the current user with all/unread/read filters, plus a `?markread=1` GET action that flips every row to is_read=1. Only 49 lines of which most is HTML; relies on the router having loaded config.php/functions.php and set $user.

nodes.name: payments.php
nodes.summary: Payment verification console for staff/admin: handles verify / reject / refund POST actions, recomputing effective price from `loyalty_cards.total_bookings` (50% off at 10+ bookings), flipping `bookings` to Deposit Paid / Confirmed, and notifying the client via addNotification(). Adds a filter+search list query over payments joined to bookings, packages, users and loyalty_cards with status-ordered counts, then renders a list view whose rows open detail / proof / reject / refund modals.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares `const RESERVATION_FEE = 100;` at file scope — a redeclaration hazard if the page were ever included twice in one request.

nodes.name: profile.php
nodes.summary: Shared self-service profile page for staff/admin (identical copy also served under pages/client) handling three POST actions — update_profile (with email uniqueness check and session resync), change_password (current-password verify + password_hash), and upload_avatar (finfo MIME sniffing, 2MB cap, writes to assets/uploads/avatars/ and unlinks the old file). Notably it does NOT call requireRole(); it only guards on `isset($user)`/`isset($role)` and redirects to login.php, and it calls db() seven separate times instead of reusing one handle.
nodes.languageNotes: No csrfField()/verifyCsrf() on any of the three forms, unlike the other pages in this batch — CSRF protection is inconsistent across the codebase.

nodes.name: schedule.php
nodes.summary: Read-only staff schedule board that groups non-cancelled bookings by date and splits each day into online vs walk-in buckets (detected from booking type or a 'WALK' booking_ref prefix), with upcoming / today / tomorrow / week views driven by a CURDATE()-based WHERE builder. No POST handling and no CSRF surface.

nodes.name: upload.php
nodes.summary: Staff photo-delivery page: CSRF-protected multi-file upload that filters extensions (jpg/jpeg/png/gif/webp/raw), caps each file at 50MB, writes into UPLOAD_DIR (assets/uploads/), inserts a `photos` row per file, and notifies the client via addNotification() once at least one file lands. Also lists Completed/Deposit Paid sessions eligible for upload and a 10-row upload history.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes to the UPLOAD_DIR constant (assets/uploads/) rather than pages/upload/payments/ — upload destinations in this project are scattered across several directories.

nodes.name: walkin.php
nodes.summary: The largest page in the batch: a walk-in booking flow that ALTERs `bookings` to add duration_minutes at request time, parses package duration strings into minutes, detects schedule conflicts, finds-or-creates the client user (issuing a random password sent via addNotification), inserts the walk-in booking plus a Pending RESERVATION payment row, bumps loyalty_cards, and notifies admin+staff. Ships ~500 lines of inline JS for package drill-down, a month calendar with availability colouring, quick-time dropdown, and an async loyalty lookup against pages/api/check-client-loyalty.php.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps every helper in `if (!function_exists(...))` because this page is reachable through more than one include path; also probes for the duration_minutes column and keeps two INSERT variants so the page survives a partially-migrated database.

nodes.name: service-workers.js
nodes.summary: Web Push service worker that displays notifications from a JSON push payload with vibrate/sound/action buttons and opens /index.php?page=notifications on click; the fetch handler is network-first with an 'Offline' 503 fallback. Dead in practice — no `navigator.serviceWorker.register()` call exists anywhere in the project, so this file is never installed.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares CACHE_NAME = 'notifications-v1' but never calls caches.open(), so the cache is unused vestigial config.

nodes.name: parsePackageDurationToMinutes
nodes.summary: Normalizes the free-text `packages.duration` column into integer minutes, handling half-day (240), whole-day (480), 'N-M hour', 'N-M min', compound 'Nh Mm', decimal hours, bare minutes, and a bare-number fallback of 60.

nodes.name: resolveBookingDurationMinutes
nodes.summary: Returns a booking's effective length in minutes, preferring the stored duration_minutes column and otherwise falling back to parsePackageDurationToMinutes() plus any '+N MIN bonus applied' marker smuggled into the booking notes.
nodes.languageNotes: The loyalty bonus is persisted by appending a human-readable line to bookings.notes, so conflict logic has to regex the notes column to reconstruct real durations.

nodes.name: parseTimeToMinutes
nodes.summary: Parses a 'h:mm AM/PM' time string into minutes-since-midnight, handling the 12 AM/PM edge cases, and returns null on any unparsable input so callers can surface a validation error.

nodes.name: calculateWalkinLoyaltyBonus
nodes.summary: Duplicates the loyalty thresholds inline — 1+ prior bookings grants a 5-minute bonus, 10+ grants a 50% discount — returning bonus_minutes / discount_pct / has_loyalty / has_discount for the walk-in booking path.
nodes.languageNotes: These 1/10 thresholds are copy-pasted from getLoyaltyTier()/getLoyaltyRewards() in functions.php rather than calling them, so the two copies can drift.

nodes.name: checkWalkinConflict
nodes.summary: Server-side double-booking guard: loads every blocking booking for the given date (Confirmed / In Progress / Completed / Deposit Paid / Approved (Unpaid)), reconstructs each one's duration via resolveBookingDurationMinutes(), and returns true if the proposed interval overlaps any of them.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses classic interval-overlap math (newStart < exEnd && newEnd > exStart) and branches its SELECT list on the runtime-probed $hasDurationColumn global.
